string.text: 7-round magazine chambered for .50 BMG rounds, fits in a M82 and any weapon it could share magazines with. It won't fit on your smaller pockets, but it's lighter. Good if you're expecting to only shoot a few rounds.

20-round drum magazine chambered for .50 BMG rounds, fits in a M82 and any weapon it could share magazines with. Someone using one of these would be preparing for an endurance sniping session, or doesn't have much confidence in their aiming.
